// with flipt trusting a throwaway certificate authority through ca_cert_path.
func redisOverTLS(ctx context.Context, client *dagger.Client, base, flipt *dagger.Container, conf testConfig) func() error {
	certPEM, keyPEM, err := throwawayRedisCert()
	if err != nil {
		return func() error { return err }
	}

	const tlsDir = "/etc/redis-tls"
	redisSvc := client.Container().
		From("redis:alpine").
		WithExposedPort(6379).
		WithNewFile(tlsDir+"/server.key", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: string(keyPEM)}).
		WithNewFile(tlsDir+"/server.crt", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: string(certPEM)}).
		WithExec([]string{
			"redis-server",
			"--port", "0",
			"--tls-port", "6379",
			"--tls-cert-file", tlsDir + "/server.crt",
			"--tls-key-file", tlsDir + "/server.key",
			"--tls-ca-cert-file", tlsDir + "/server.crt",
			"--tls-auth-clients", "no",
		}).
		AsService()

	flipt = flipt.
		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG").
		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_ENABLED", "true").
		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_BACKEND", "redis").
		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_HOST", "redis").
		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_REQUIRE_TLS", "true").
		WithNewFile(tlsDir+"/ca.crt", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: string(certPEM)}).
		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_CA_CERT_PATH", tlsDir+"/ca.crt").
		WithServiceBinding("redis", redisSvc)
	return suite(ctx, "api", base, flipt.WithExec(nil), conf)
}

// throwawayRedisCert makes a self-signed certificate for the host "redis",
// valid for an hour, which is also its own certificate authority.
func throwawayRedisCert() (certPEM, keyPEM []byte, err error) {
	serial, err := rand.Int(rand.Reader, new(big.Int).Lsh(big.NewInt(1), 128))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	signer, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	now := time.Now()
	tmpl := x509.Certificate{
		SerialNumber: serial,
		IsCA:         true,
		DNSNames:     []string{"redis"},
		NotBefore:    now,
		NotAfter:     now.Add(time.Hour),
	}
	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, &tmpl, &tmpl, &signer.PublicKey, signer)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	certPEM = pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der})
	keyPEM = pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "RSA PRIVATE KEY", Bytes: x509.MarshalPKCS1PrivateKey(signer)})
	return certPEM, keyPEM, nil
}
